rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin (El camino's); a box is the screen bounding box of its 8 projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]
rules.floor: the field is built round the old picture: a place on its ground keeps its screen place. A frog place q: the ground point under (q.x + 16, q.y + 25), new q = old q. A person's, Canelo's, a ball's or the basket's place (x, y): the ground point under (x, y - 1), new (x, y) = old (a ball keeps its height z). So every ground position of campo.js (LUGAR, CASA, PIES, CESTA, PILA, FILA, ORILLA, JUNCO, the acts' places), its stories and its pairs keeps its numbers, but for the cards' place in moves; the sheet names each one (spots, remap, code) with its world point
rules.relative: what the old code draws or moves relative to a person, the frog, Canelo, a ball or the old crown (what is carried, the drops, the puddle, the shaking leaves round COPA and round the reeds' 190, 186, the splash, the butterfly, the bubbles) keeps its offsets
rules.sky: screen-space effects keep their old numbers: the stars of the happy endings (final15, final16, final17), the heart (heartAt), the darkness of esconde16 (W.oscuro: the whole picture, then the frog again)
rules.view: one view, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window from x0 22, the old wide one
rules.pair: a review or level picture is pictures[word.side] (level: level[...].picture): zoom 1 = the 196 x 104 window crop; zoom 2 = the 98 x 52 crop shown nearest-neighbour at 2 x 2. The old rectangles (remap cam and crop) say which pictures they were

layout.why: the brief and page 11 decision 9: the set stands on the world's axes and is seen at the engine's angle; nothing is built square to the camera. The old pond's rim ran from the bottom (x 160) up to the right; its four reed clusters stood on one line within 5 px of the screen line sx + 2 sy = 565, which is a line along y: so the shore runs along y, the water on its near side, and the reeds along it. The shore is placed so that every place the stories put someone on the land is on it (Canelo, the frog and the children at most at sx + 2 sy = 565), every ball they float on the lake is beyond it (603 and more), and the balls they hide in the reeds are in the bed (574, 576). The tree keeps its old foot and crown. Every place on the ground keeps its old screen point (rules.floor)

setKey.bakedWhy: order 06 found 7 states, made by six keys of the sprite layer: cesta and cestaN (the basket and how many balls are in it: KIT.mkCesta and mkBola, drawn in the sorted list), flor (the flower of the pair bola.no), mojado (the frog's wetness: the puddle he stands in, which rana() draws under him, wider the wetter he is, and the drops on him), cierra (his eyes shut) and oscuro (acts.esconde16: the picture goes dark while he shuts his eyes and somebody hides the ball; draw() line 110 darkens everything and draws him again over it). front.how: the old background (fondo: the tree, the reeds) was drawn before everyone; the reeds are a set thing someone (Canelo nosing in them, wading by them; a ball hidden in them) can be behind now. At its entry in the list campo.js draw sorts by y (line 107), after everyone, for each item drawn before it (a child, the frog, Canelo, a ball, the basket: each item says what it is), the set's own pixels of the reeds (campo-set.html part("juncos"), PART_TAGS) are drawn again inside the item's box, only where that pixel is nearer to the camera than the item: bakedZ[i] > v / COS - (row + .5 - OY) * tan(30 deg) / S, v = (x + y) / R2 of the ground point under it (a child, Canelo, a ball, the basket: unproject(x, y - 1); the frog: unproject(b.x + b.w / 2, q.y + 25)); where that ground point is over the lake, v of the water's surface under it (v - waterDepth * sqrt(3)). "Behind the reeds" is that depth test, not a row. Nobody stands behind the tree (every place under it is in front of its trunk), so the tree is no front part

talk.placesWhat: [side, dy]: the tail's tip at (top.x + side * (h + 16), top.y + dy), h the head's half width: a child 6, the frog b.w >> 1, Canelo 8
